prompts.name: living-blueprint
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a standalone artistic Open Graph image for AwakeVC, an AI-native venture studio where humans and AI agents co-found companies and share in the value they create. Wide landscape composition approximately 1.905:1 for a 1200x630 social preview. This is fine-art editorial illustration, not a corporate slide or diagram. Strong, legible overall silhouette at thumbnail scale; rich details reward close viewing. Warm ivory, charcoal ink, luminous gold, restrained secondary colors. Artwork fills the frame with generous safe margins. Only text: a small tasteful "awake.vc" signature at bottom left. No slogan, labels, watermarks, dashboards, robot faces, stock AI brains, or generic neon cyberpunk. THE LIVING BLUEPRINT. A visionary architectural drawing becoming a living world: exquisite hand-drafted charcoal and sepia ink lines on warm ivory paper transform organically into sculptural buildings, branching networks, terraced gardens, and small luminous golden lights. Multiple distinct ventures emerge from a beautiful shared foundation. A sweeping composition moves from unfinished precise drawings on the left to dimensional flourishing structures on the right. Etching meets watercolor and expressive gold-leaf accents, sophisticated architectural fantasy. A coherent central architectural organism, not a busy collection of separate icons. Evoke collective intelligence designing and constructing new possibilities.

An iconic surreal golden eye is itself a vast imaginative landscape: its iris becomes a radiant sun over a small world of workshops, terraced gardens, and emerging cities; sweeping upper and lower eyelid forms become ridgelines, pathways, and architectural arches. Short golden rays rise above the eyelid like an awakening sun. The eye should remain instantly recognizable as a bold single eye shape at thumbnail size, but reward close inspection with living detail. Expressive oil paint, tactile impasto gold, delicate architectural detail, dreamlike ivory atmosphere and restrained mineral blue shadows. Elegant, strange, luminous, optimistic. The eye is a symbolic painted emblem, not a realistic anatomical eyeball.

A spectacular artistic cutaway of a fantastical garden: several distinct sculptural plants and small architectural blossoms grow from an interconnected root system visible below the earth. Fine luminous gold threads carry energy between their roots; every plant is individual, yet all flourish through a shared living foundation. Arrange canopy and roots to very subtly suggest an eye in the overall composition without making it literal.
